name: lpthw-learner
description: Local-only Learn Python (LPTHW + Async/LLM + PyTorch) interactive learner

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.generate:content: uv run python scripts/generate_content.py && uv run python scripts/annotate_starters.py
scripts.generate:lfs: uv run python scripts/gen_llm_from_scratch.py && uv run python scripts/annotate_starters.py
